name: 心象天儀本線 ~Per aspera ad astra~
detailed_description:
Story

Hoshiori Academy—

A cloistered world built around the colossal furnace known as the Stellaforge.

Within this enclosure, students known as Starweaving Maidens offer what they hold dearest to the furnace for the sake of the stars' continued existence.

They have repeated this ritual countless times, burning their love, their wishes, and their destinies.

Until one day, Tsubaki Ueshima—an impurity left behind by the burning—unexpectedly crashes into their perfect cycle.

With her arrival, the academy’s long-buried secrets begin to surface…

“Board the train, and follow the path drawn by the Asterail.”

Playtime

Estimated playtime: 10 to 12 hours.

Features

  • A dreamlike visual and narrative style, capturing scenes that feel both unreal and achingly familiar.

  • A unique blend of real-world photography and fictional characters creates a deeply immersive panorama beyond dimensions.

  • Over 50 original tracks composed by 10lulu, delivering a rich and immersive musical experience.

Characters

Ueshima Tsubaki

A transfer student who carries an otherworldly atmosphere.


Gentle and kind-hearted, with strict views on etiquette, yet prone to flights of fancy. Her inner thoughts often slip out unbidden.
She’s good at taking care of others, yet unconsciously keeps everyone at a distance.

Sensitive to the charms of other girls. Oddly good at noticing when someone has a grain of rice stuck to their face.

Deep in her heart, she yearns for "genuine friendship."

Hoshino Suzuno

A quiet, enigmatic girl who speaks in phrases that sound more like cryptic codes than conversation.

She has a strange affinity for blue skies, the scent of plastic, and dirty jokes.

Harbors a twisted streak—if she found a fish tank, she might just “accidentally” kill the goldfish inside.

Noogi Rie

President of the Literature Club.
Whimsical, emotional, and full of dramatic flair. Loves acting and harmless pranks.

Her every gesture resembles a stage performance.
Though she may seem carefree, she’s earnest at heart and always gives her best within her limits.

If she lived under internet coverage, she'd probably be a YouTuber doing challenges like "Reading Wordsworth While Eating Million-Scoville Spicy Ramen."

Sasamoto Riona

A classic "tragic beauty" with the grace of a Yamato Nadeshiko.

Calm, distant, and self-destructive, she spends most of her time indoors reading or playing piano.

Though she appears cold at first glance, only with Rie does she open her heart, bantering like old friends.

Her sharp retorts are renowned for their ability to drag Rie from her theatrical daily life back to reality.

supported_languages: Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, English

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: Intel i3 8th gen or above
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 760
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11.0 Big Sur
  • Processor: Apple M1 或 Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 GPU / Intel Iris Plus / AMD Radeon Pro 555
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: 內建音效裝置

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS 或等效發行版
  • Processor: Intel i3 第8代 或 AMD Ryzen 3 以上
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 760 / AMD Radeon R9 280X（需支援 Vulkan）
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: 支援 ALSA 或 PulseAudio 的音效卡
